content: WaylandSwitcher (Balans097, Nim, MIT, Fedora/GNOME Wayland): PAUSE=fix last word back to nearest space; Shift+PAUSE=whole phrase + case change; selection correction via clipboard round-trip (wl-clipboard on Wayland, xclip/xsel on X11); interactive configurator; systemd self-install; requires root and EVIOCGRAB (monopolizes keyboard, incompatible with keyd/xremap). No double/triple-shift, no documented case preservation, no exception rules, no per-app behavior, no config file. Direct predecessor of goswitch.
